def player_pos(frame):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    rows=[]; cols=[]
    for i in range(64):
        for j in range(64):
            if a[i][j] in 'bY':
                rows.append(i); cols.append(j)
    return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
print("start", player_pos(current_frame))
for k in range(6):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print(k, player_pos(current_frame))
